cards.text: Friend, Jephthah and the judges after him, Ibzan, Elon and Abdon, have each judged Israel and died (Judges 12:7-15). Then it happens: "Again the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD," and He delivers them into an enemy's hand for forty years.

cards.question: Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD again. Who does He deliver them into the hand of?

cards.text: Now meet Manoah, a man from Zorah, from the clan of the Danites, whose wife was barren and had no children. Then the angel of the LORD appears to her, not to Manoah, and tells her it's true she's barren, and then he flips the whole thing around.

cards.question: The angel of the LORD tells Manoah's wife it's true she is barren. Then he flips it. What does he say will happen?

answers.text: She will conceive and give birth to a son
She will care for an orphan from her clan
She will live to see Israel set free

cards.text: And he's not done: "Now please be careful not to drink wine or strong drink, and not to eat anything unclean."
Then the angel gets specific about the boy: "And no razor shall touch his head, because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb…" My mustache just stood up and applauded.

cards.question: Israel is in the hand of the Philistines. What does the angel say this boy will do?

answers.text: Begin to set Israel free from them
Make peace between Israel and them
Rule over Israel as its king

cards.text: So the woman goes and tells her husband a man of God came to her, his appearance like the angel of God, "exceedingly awesome." She says she never asked where he came from.

cards.question: Manoah's wife tells him the man of God never told her his name.
When Manoah's wife repeats the angel's message to her husband, she leaves out the part about no razor touching the boy's head.

cards.text: Then Manoah prays to the LORD. Some of us would've hit the group chat first, friend, but Manoah takes it right to the top.

cards.question: Manoah prays for the man of God to come again and teach them how to ___ the boy who is to be born.

cards.text: "And God listened to the voice of Manoah," and the angel of God comes back to the woman while she's sitting in the field.

cards.question: When the angel of God returns, Manoah is in the field with his wife.
The angel of God has come back, and Manoah isn't with his wife. What does she do?

answers.text: She runs quickly to tell her husband
She asks the angel to come home with her
She sends a servant to find Manoah

cards.text: She tells him, "Behold, the man who came to me the other day has reappeared!" Manoah prayed for this visit and wasn't even in the field for it, like waiting all day on a delivery, stepping away for ONE minute, and hearing the doorbell from the other room.
So Manoah got up and followed his wife. He walks right up and asks, "Are you the man who spoke to my wife?"

cards.question: The man tells Manoah he is the one who spoke to his wife.

cards.text: Then Manoah asks, "When your words come to pass, what will be the boy’s rule of life and mission?" I spent years in a junk drawer next to a pile of old instruction manuals, friend, and Manoah would've read EVERY one.

cards.question: Manoah asks about the boy's rule of life and mission. How does the angel of the LORD answer?

answers.text: His wife must do all the angel told her
Manoah must take the boy to the priests
Manoah must teach the boy to fight

cards.question: The angel adds that Manoah's wife must not eat anything that comes from the vine.

cards.text: "Please stay here," Manoah says, so they can prepare a young goat for him. This man is NOT letting a guest leave without feeding him.

cards.question: Manoah offers to prepare a young goat for the angel of the LORD. What does the angel say?

answers.text: They should offer it up instead
He will gladly stay and eat it
They should save it for the birth

cards.text: Manoah did not know that it was the angel of the LORD. Then he asks for a name, so they can honor him when his word comes to pass.

cards.question: The angel of the LORD tells Manoah his name.

cards.text: Instead he asks, "Why do you ask my name," and says it's beyond comprehension.
Then Manoah offers a young goat and a grain offering on a rock to the LORD. As Manoah and his wife look on, "the LORD did a marvelous thing."

cards.question: When the flame goes up from the altar to the sky, the angel of the LORD ___ in the flame.
When Manoah and his wife see the angel go up in the flame, they fall facedown to the ground.

cards.text: The angel of the LORD doesn't appear to them again, and "Manoah realized that it had been the angel of the LORD." That's like chatting with a guy for ten minutes, he walks off, and THEN it hits you: that was the new boss.

cards.question: Manoah realizes they saw the angel of the LORD, and I bet his heart is pounding. What does he tell his wife?

answers.text: We must go after the angel
We must tell all of Zorah

cards.question: Manoah is sure they're going to die. What reason does his wife give that they won't?

answers.text: The angel promised them long life
They obeyed every rule he gave

cards.text: His wife keeps going: the LORD wouldn't have shown them all these things or spoken to them this way. She didn't bring an argument, friend, she brought a whole case file.
So the woman gives birth to a son and names him Samson, and somewhere a barber just sighed. "The boy grew, and the LORD blessed him."

cards.question: As Samson grows, something begins to stir him at Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol. What is it?

cards.text: That's where we'll leave it for now, friend. Keep your apron on, because the oven on Samson's story is only just warming up.
